cases.disposition_reason: jackin --scenario first-use --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120×40. world_for(FirstUse) in src/bin/jackin/domain/fixtures.rs builds base_world, whose Arbiter::new(0) is an empty discovery, and sets discovery_pending. request_entry in src/bin/jackin/arbiter.rs returns PlayIntro for Ok(0) when foreign_claim is false. start in src/bin/jackin/app.rs stores IntroState. render_intro for Motion::Reduced in src/bin/jackin/rain.rs draws CAPTION Knock, knock, operator. and the hint Enter Continue. intro_guard starts at 3. After it reaches 0, Enter calls IntroState::skip, reduced skip sets tick to REDUCED_HOLD, and finish_intro calls complete_entry and enter_manager. The manager shows Current directory, not saved, no instances, and Create a workspace from this directory. Ctrl+Q exits 0.
cases.return_path: Enter after the intro guard skips into the manager; Ctrl+Q exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: intro_guard starts at 3 in src/bin/jackin/app.rs and decrements on ticks. While intro_guard > 0 and motion is not Paused, sequence_key consumes Enter and Esc. Enter queued for that first poll, while intro_guard is still 3, leaves Knock, knock, operator. on screen. After the guard, Enter calls IntroState::skip. For Motion::Reduced, skip in src/bin/jackin/rain.rs sets tick to REDUCED_HOLD (45), the phase becomes Done, and finish_intro enters the manager. The manager is Current directory with not saved and no instances, and it appears inside the reduced hold rather than after it. The checkpoints are that phrase, at 120×40 and then at 80×24 after resize(80, 24), before resize(120, 40) and before Enter. render_intro draws CAPTION, the pill, and hint Enter Continue. Ctrl+C after the guard calls release_entry and sets quit. The process exits 0, and Current directory, Resolving launch identity, and the-architect stay absent. --scenario returning uses populated in src/bin/jackin/domain/fixtures.rs, so request_entry returns JoinActive and start enters the manager. That screen shows the-architect and 2 running, and Knock, knock, operator. is absent. skip_animation in src/bin/jackin/app.rs replays Enter only when click_skips_animation is set. This leaf does not click.
cases.action_sequence: Press Enter while the intro guard still consumes it. Shoot the phrase at 120×40, resize to 80×24, shoot it, resize back, then Enter into the manager. Ctrl+C after the guard aborts. Launch --scenario returning.
cases.expected_results: The phrase stays through the guard and through both checkpoints. Enter after the guard reaches the empty manager. Ctrl+C exits 0 without the manager or the cockpit. Returning joins the manager and does not show the first-use phrase.
cases.forbidden_effects: Enter during the guard skips the intro. Ctrl+C opens the manager or the cockpit. Returning presents the empty-discovery intro.
